exercises.why: **совпадают** — совпада́ть (imperfective): to coincide; to concur; to match, to agree. Wiktionary: со- + в- + пада́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: His opinion was the same as mine.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to fall, to drop, to sink, to decline
to abate, to fall (to decrease or become less in strength)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: попа́сть — to hit (a target); упа́сть — to fall, to drop; па́дать — to fall, to drop, to sink, to decline; спасть — to abate, to fall (to decrease or become less in strength).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пропасть — precipice, abyss, chasm; пасть — (dated, literary) to fall; попада́ть — to hit (a target); напа́сть — misfortune, bad luck, trouble.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to drop out, to fall out
to fall down (to), to press oneself (to)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: впасть — (river) to fall (into), to flow (into); вы́пасть — to drop out, to fall out; припа́сть — to fall down (to), to press oneself (to); совпада́ть — to coincide.
